verses.translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

translations.ron: Cerurile spun slava lui Dumnezeu şi facerea mâinilor Lui o vesteşte tăria.
translations.grk: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυίδ.

verses.translation: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament proclaims the work of his hands.

translations.ron: Ziua zilei spune cuvânt, şi noaptea nopţii vesteşte ştiinţă.
translations.grk: Οἱ οὐρανοὶ διηγοῦνται δόξαν Θεοῦ, ποίησιν δὲ χειρῶν αὐτοῦ ἀναγγέλλει τὸ στερέωμα.

verses.translation: Day to day utters speech, and night to night proclaims knowledge.

translations.ron: Nu sunt graiuri, nici cuvinte, ale căror glasuri să nu se audă.
translations.grk: Ἡμέρα τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐρεύγεται ῥῆμα, καὶ νὺξ νυκτὶ ἀναγγέλλει γνῶσιν.

verses.translation: There are no speeches or words, in which their voices are not heard.

translations.ron: În tot pământul a ieşit vestirea lor, şi la marginile lumii cuvintele lor.
translations.grk: Οὐκ εἰσὶ λαλιαὶ οὐδὲ λόγοι, ὧν οὐχὶ ἀκούονται αἱ φωναὶ αὐτῶν·

verses.translation: Their voice is gone out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world.

translations.ron: În soare şi-a pus locaşul său; şi el este ca un mire ce iese din cămara sa.
translations.grk: Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἐξῆλθεν ὁ φθόγγος αὐτῶν, καὶ εἰς τὰ πέρατα τῆς οἰκουμένης τὰ ῥήματα αὐτῶν·

verses.translation: In the sun he has set his tabernacle; and he comes forth as a bridegroom out of his chamber: he will exult as a giant to run his course.

translations.ron: Bucura-se-va ca un uriaş, care aleargă drumul lui.
translations.grk: ἐν τῷ ἡλίῳ ἔθετο τὸ σκήνωμα αὐτοῦ, καὶ αὐτὸς ὡς νυμφίος ἐκπορευόμενος ἐκ παστοῦ αὐτοῦ· ἀγαλλιάσεται ὡς γίγας δραμεῖν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: His going forth is from the extremity of heaven, and his circuit to the other end of heaven: and no one shall be hidden from his heat.

translations.ron: De la marginea cerului ieşirea lui, şi oprirea lui până la marginea cerului; şi nu este cine să se ascundă de căldura lui.
translations.grk: Ἀπʼ ἄκρου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἡ ἔξοδος αὐτοῦ· καὶ τὸ κατάντημα αὐτοῦ ἕως ἄκρου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ· καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὃς ἀποκρυβήσεται τὴν θέρμην αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: The law of the Lord is perfect, converting souls: the testimony of the Lord is faithful, instructing babes.

translations.ron: Legea Domnului este fără prihană, întoarce sufletele; mărturia Domnului este credincioasă, înţelepţeşte pruncii;
translations.grk: Ὁ νόμος τοῦ Κυρίου ἄμωμος ἐπιστρέφων ψυχὰς, ἡ μαρτυρία Κυρίου πιστὴ σοφίζουσα νήπια.

verses.translation: The ordinances of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the Lord is bright, enlightening the eyes.

translations.ron: Judecăţile Domnului sunt drepte, veselesc inima; porunca Domnului este strălucitoare, luminează ochii.
translations.grk: Τὰ δικαιώματα Κυρίου εὐθέα εὐφραίνοντα καρδίαν, ἡ ἐντολὴ Κυρίου τηλαυγὴς φωτίζουσα ὀφθαλμούς.

verses.translation: The fear of the Lord is pure, enduring for ever and ever: the judgments of the Lord are true, and justified altogether.

translations.ron: Frica de Domnul este curată, rămâne în veacul veacului. Judecăţile Domnului sunt adevărate, toate îndreptăţite.
translations.grk: Ὁ φόβος Κυρίου ἁγνὸς διαμένων εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος, τὰ κρίματα Κυρίου ἀληθινὰ δεδικαιωμένα ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό·

verses.translation: To be desired more than gold, and much precious stone: sweeter also than honey and the honey-comb.

translations.ron: Dorite sunt mai mult decât aurul, şi decât piatra cea de mare preţ; şi mai dulci decât mierea şi fagurele.
translations.grk: Ἐπιθυμητὰ ὑπὲρ χρυσίον καὶ λίθον τίμιον πολὺν, καὶ γλυκύτερα ὑπὲρ μέλι καὶ κηρίον.

verses.translation: For thy servant keeps to them: in the keeping of them there is great reward.

translations.ron: Că robul Tău le păzeşte pe ele, şi răsplătire multă are.
translations.grk: Καὶ γὰρ ὁ δοῦλός σου φυλάσσει αὐτὰ, ἐν τῷ φυλάσσειν αὐτὰ ἀνταπόδοσις πολλή.

verses.translation: Who will understand his transgressions? purge thou me from my secret sins.

translations.ron: Greşelile cine le va pricepe? De cele ascunse ale mele curăţeşte-mă
translations.grk: Παραπτώματα τίς συνήσει; ἐκ τῶν κρυφίων μου καθάρισόν με,

verses.translation: And spare thy servant the attack of strangers: if they do not gain the dominion over me, then shall I be blameless, and I shall be clear from great sin.

translations.ron: Şi de cele străine fereşte pe robul Tău; de nu mă vor stăpâni, atunci fără prihană voi fi şi mă voi curăţi de păcat mare.
translations.grk: καὶ ἀπὸ ἀλλοτρίων φεῖσαι τοῦ δούλου σου· ἐὰν μή μου κατακυριεύσωσι, τότε ἄμωμος ἔσομαι, καὶ καθαρισθήσομαι ἀπὸ ἁμαρτίας μεγάλης.

verses.translation: So shall the sayings of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be pleasing continually before thee, O Lord my helper, and my redeemer.

translations.ron: Şi vor bineplăcea cuvintele gurii mele şi cugetul inimii mele înaintea Ta pururea; Doamne, Ajutorul meu şi Izbăvitorul meu.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσονται εἰς εὐδοκίαν τὸ λόγια τοῦ στόματός μου, καὶ ἡ μελέτη τῆς καρδίας μου ἐνώπιόν σου διαπαντός· Κύριε βοηθέ μου, καὶ λυτρωτά μου.
